g.text: : zero order M/s, first order /s, second order /(M s)
Only the first half-life is the same. The next halving takes 5 s (zero), 10 s (first)
and 20 s (second) from 0.50 M, because the half-life of a second-order reaction
falls and that of a zero-order reaction shrinks.
In (b) and (c) the dashed curves are the other two orders: they bend.
